subject: Axiom Digital: annotated SIG/CAIQ workbook + per-tenant log deletion attestation
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@axiom-digital.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <agomez@axiom-digital.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: annotated SIG/CAIQ workbook + tenant deletion attestation

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well. Our SOC 2 auditor requested an annotated SIG/CAIQ workbook that highlights any customer-facing deviations from the public controls mapping and a separate attestation document confirming Redwood's per-tenant log deletion process and timelines. Specifically we need:

- Annotations in the SIG/CAIQ workbook that call out the 90-day debug/session-log retention we requested for a subset of tenants vs Redwood's default 30-day debug retention.
- A PDF attestation we can provide to our legal/audit team confirming: what is retained per-tenant, who has access to tenant debug artifacts, how deletion is executed and verified, and the expected evidence delivery window.

Our timeline is tight — auditor kickoff is Dec 7 and they want the workbook + attestation before Dec 3. Attached is a short spreadsheet with the tenant IDs we want to scope (AXD-PRD-12, AXD-STG-08, AXD-INT-03). Can you confirm whether you can populate the workbook with callouts and provide a signed attestation by Dec 2?

Also: one of our legal reviewers (Morgan & Co.) may ask for a sample proof-of-delete for the tenant-level debug logs — can you advise what artifacts Redwood can provide?

Thanks,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Security Engineering, Axiom Digital
sonia.patel@axiom-digital.com
+1 415 555 0184

Attachment: AXD-tenant-list-20261124.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@axiom-digital.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <agomez@axiom-digital.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: annotated SIG/CAIQ workbook + tenant deletion attestation

Hi Sonia — thank you for the clear ask and the tenant list. We can support this scope; high-level answers up front:

- We will populate the SIG/CAIQ workbook with inline annotations that call out the 90-day per-tenant debug/session retention for the tenant IDs you provided and where that sits relative to our default retention profile.
- We will produce a signed deletion attestation PDF that outlines the steps we take to delete tenant-scoped debug logs (API job + object lifecycle + deletion manifest) and the artifacts we can deliver to demonstrate deletion.

A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope artifacts correctly:
1) Do you need proof-of-delete for both live storage (S3-like object deletion) and any forensic snapshots/archives?
2) For the legal hold (if invoked) — do you expect Redwood to pause auto-deletes for the affected tenant and provide an export, or is your expectation that we retain an immutable forensic snapshot for your internal review?

I'm attaching our attestation template (axiom-tenant-deletion-attestation-template.pdf) and an annotated SIG workbook template we usually start from (Axiom_SIG_annotated_workbook.xlsx). If timeline works, can we schedule a 20-minute sync on Mon Nov 29 at 11am PT to run through the annotations and confirm the exact artifacts Morgan & Co. are looking for? If you prefer, we can proceed asynchronously and deliver by Dec 2.

I'll loop in Marissa (evidence & exports) and Ben (tooling & deletion verification) on the follow-up.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: axiom-tenant-deletion-attestation-template.pdf, Axiom_SIG_annotated_workbook.xlsx
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@axiom-digital.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <agomez@axiom-digital.com>, Morgan & Co. Legal <legal@morgan-co.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: annotated SIG/CAIQ workbook + tenant deletion attestation

Thanks Rachel — this looks good and the template is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Proof-of-delete: we need evidence of deletion for both primary object storage and any temporary forensic snapshots. The auditor expects a manifest (list of object keys + deletion timestamp + deletion job id) and a signed cover letter attesting the deletion was executed by Redwood.
- Legal hold: We have a high-risk tenant (AXD-PRD-12) where a legal hold may be invoked by Dec 1. If a hold is requested, we'll expect Redwood to stop automated deletion for that tenant and provide a forensics export within 48 hours. If a hold is not invoked, the 90-day retention carveout is acceptable.

I attached a short doc from Morgan & Co. with their standard evidence matrix (redlines in the file). Also attached is an updated tenant list (AXD-PRD-12, AXD-STG-08, AXD-INT-03). If you can confirm the manifest fields you can populate and whether the attestation can be signed by Dec 2, we can lock the timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — the auditor will be strict on artifacts.

Sonia
Attachment: AXD-tenant-list-20261126.xlsx, MorganCo-evidence-matrix.docx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Axiom Digital: annotated SIG/CAIQ workbook + per-tenant log deletion attestation

Folks — forwarding Axiom's requests and Morgan & Co. evidence matrix. Action items to meet the auditor deadline (Dec 7) and deliver by Dec 2: 

Marissa: Can you populate the Axiom_SIG_annotated_workbook.xlsx with the inline control callouts for the three tenant IDs and attach screenshots/paths for where tenant debug/session logs are stored (include object key patterns and retention lifecycle policies). The auditor wants explicit mapping for which controls are impacted.

Ben: Please prepare the deletion manifest sample and the proof-of-delete workflow for both primary storage and forensic snapshots. The manifest should include object key, deletion timestamp (ISO), deletion job id, and the audit-trail link (if available). Can you confirm whether we can deliver a signed cover letter (PDF) by EOD Dec 2 and the sample manifest for AXD-PRD-12?

Jordan: loop with Sales/legal on the contract carveout language for the 90-day per-tenant retention and the legal-hold pause process. We may need a one-paragraph addendum for Axiom's SOC2 packet.

Timeline: deliver draft workbook + sample manifest to Sonia by Dec 2. If Axiom invokes a legal hold by Dec 1, we will pause deletion for AXD-PRD-12 and prepare an expedited forensics export (48h SLA).

Please confirm acceptance of items and flag blockers. I'm happy to join a 20-min sync with Axiom on Nov 29 if helpful — Sonia, are you still available at 11am PT?

Thanks — Rachel

P.S. Links to templates: https://drive.redwood.internal/secure/AXD-SIG-annotated (workbook)
